name: Mary Jones | 100mg Soda | Root Beer
description:
Same Jones.
More Mary.
More flavors, higher dosages, only available in dispensaries.

100mg Soda Beverage

Mary Jones’ Root Beer is a rebellious take on the traditional, infused with an incredibly flavorful, nostalgic taste that defies the ordinary. It’s crafted for the free-spirited who crave something truly exceptional in every sip.
